newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Aug 14.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Aug 14.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to shipping on Thursday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
Tropical storm Hilda was downgraded to a Tropical Depression and drifting further from Mexico's coast. She was spotted in the Pacific about 890 miles (1240 km) west of the Socorro island.
A new storm system was spotted 425 miles (680 km) south of the Socorro island, moving west in the Pacific and expected to become a tropical depression by the weekend.
Scattered showers registered along the Pacific coast, with possible thunder showers seen later in the day along Sinaloa and Michoacan states.

Rains also in the Gulf Coast along Veracruz, Tabasco and Tamaulipas coasts, and in the Caribbean region in Quintana Roo state, Belize, Honduras and Nicaragua. ((--Timna Tanners, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-7903))
